_comment: Accepted proving circuits (EE-EUDIW-TS-1.0 EE-ZKP-030). A relying party checks a proof's circuit against this set BEFORE verifying it, and caches it rather than fetching per presentation (EE-ZKP-032). In production this file is signed, append-only and CT-logged; this is a local stand-in. The block_enc_hash/block_enc_sig pair is the Longfellow block sizes the multipaz zkSystemSpec label carries (multipaz-circuits.txt); it takes part in the spec id only.
